name: Sterling-Nakamura Suppression Net Launcher SNL-2 'Spider'
description: A shoulder-fired launcher that deploys a weighted conductive net designed to entangle and incapacitate targets. The net spans 4 meters when deployed and carries a conductive mesh that can deliver a sustained taser-grade electrical discharge for up to 30 seconds, keeping the entangled target immobilized. The net's edge weights are designed to wrap around limbs and torso, and the conductive fibers tighten under tension — struggling makes the entanglement worse and increases the contact area for electrical discharge. Sterling-Nakamura markets it as their premier non-lethal capture system.
specifications:
net span: 4 meters deployed
electrical discharge: 50,000V taser-grade, 30-second sustained
effective range: 5-20 meters
launcher weight: 4.2 kg
net weight: 1.5 kg per cartridge
cartridges: Single-shot, reload in 8 seconds
conductive fiber: Copper-core polymer weave
tensile strength: Rated to 200 kg pull force
story_hooks: Modified Spider nets have appeared that replace the electrical discharge with a contact sedative coating — targets are wrapped and unconscious within seconds, ideal for abduction.

A Spider net was used to capture a heavily augmented fugitive, but the electrical discharge interacted with their military-grade cyberware and caused a catastrophic power surge that killed three bystanders.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions CrisisNet BT-4 Battlefield Triage

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutalist shoulder-mounted launcher with a pronounced, angular frame. The main body is dominated by a wide cylindrical chamber angled slightly downward, giving it an aggressive forward lean. Twin stabilizing rails extend from the stock to the muzzle, creating a skeletal, weapon-ready silhouette. The overall impression is industrial and purposeful—unmistakably a tool of restraint and control.
physical_description.dimensions: Total length: 78 cm | Barrel/launch tube: 45 cm | Width at chamber: 12 cm | Height with sights: 22 cm | Cartridge profile: 8 cm diameter × 6 cm depth
physical_description.weight_description: Hefty but balanced. The 4.2 kg launcher sits comfortably on a shoulder mount with weight distributed toward the rear stock. The recoil impulse is managed by the frame geometry, making it feel planted rather than jarring. Single-handed manipulation is possible but requires upper-body strength.
physical_description.primary_material: Hardened polymer composite frame with reinforced steel mounting points and launch tube. Internal mechanics are steel and titanium alloy for electrical isolation and durability.
physical_description.finish: Matte tactical black polymer with brushed steel accents around the launch tube opening and breech mechanism. Wear patterns show scuffed corners and scratches exposing darker underlayers—typical field use.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: Deep matte black | Accent: Gun-metal gray steel on launch tube rim, breech cover, and rail mounting hardware | Subtle corp branding in silver
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured rubberized polymer grip with subtle grid pattern for gloved operation. The shoulder stock is wrapped in thin neoprene for comfort under armor. Tactile feedback is intentional—users need to feel their hold during precision aiming.
distinctive_features: Twin stabilizing rails running full length of weapon, creating open framework geometry
Large cylindrical net cartridge chamber with visible copper-weave mesh outline visible through translucent polymer section
Integrated optical sight rail with standard mounting pattern—most units field a laser rangefinder or tactical HUD link
Breech release lever with textured grip—oversized for rapid reload under tension
Discharge indicator light strip running along the right rail—amber during standby, red during active electrical discharge on deployed net
Vent louvers on upper chamber surface for thermal dissipation of electrical charge cycles
Serial/batch number stamped on left rail in white lettering
Wear-resistant polymer coating shows minor cracks and impact scuffs consistent with 200+ deployments
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Sterling-Nakamura corporate logo (interlocked S-N emblem) stamped in silver on the left side of the chamber. 'SNL-2 SPIDER' designation in white sans-serif lettering below logo. Small 'LICENSED LAW ENFORCEMENT ONLY' warning plate on the right rail near the trigger guard.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained but field-worn. Scratches on the polymer frame, light scuffing on the rails, slight discoloration around the discharge indicator from repeated electrical cycling. No rust or corrosion—materials are protected. Cartridge chamber shows fine wear marks from rapid reloads. Optics may be aftermarket or upgraded depending on department issue.
